target_architecture.first_target: standalone shadow/parity Expert; no B02/F05 source modification
target_architecture.portfolio_integration: separate later stage after standalone parity
target_architecture.magic_number: must be unique and collision-checked in the later Core implementation PR; value is not part of research semantics

runtime_information_contract.decision_trigger: the first OnTick callback that observes a new M15 bar

completed_bar_mapping.shock_reference_window: 96 completed observed M15 bars ending at shift 2; shifts 2 through 97 inclusive

runtime_information_contract.server_time: bar computation may use broker server time, but every emitted identity must include canonical UTC
runtime_information_contract.utc_conversion: must use a frozen, tested historical conversion table or rule; implicit machine-local timezone conversion is prohibited
runtime_information_contract.price_source: Bid bars for signal; current Bid/Ask quote for execution

state_machine.WARMUP_to_IDLE: required completed-bar history and evaluation admission boundary are satisfied
state_machine.IDLE_to_OPEN_DECISION: completed shift-2 shock plus shift-1 failure satisfy the frozen predicates and reentry suppression
state_machine.OPEN_DECISION_to_OPEN: submit on the same first tick; capture decision quote and actual fill separately
state_machine.OPEN_to_CLOSE_DECISION: current tick timestamp >= frozen decision boundary + 7200 seconds
state_machine.CLOSE_DECISION_to_CLOSED: close on that first tick and capture decision quote and actual fill separately
state_machine.any_order_error: INVALID_RUN for binding parity; no later tick may be silently substituted

execution_contract.entry_time_anchor: failure completion boundary, not actual OrderSend fill time
execution_contract.exit_time_anchor: entry decision boundary + 7200 seconds, not actual fill time + 7200 seconds
execution_contract.retry_note: A retry changes the first-executable-tick contract. Any production retry policy requires a separate execution-robustness authorization.

event_consumption_and_reentry.binding_rule: candidate failure index j must be strictly greater than previous admitted failure index + 9

logging_contract.canonical_float_serialization: decimal text with sufficient precision for 1e-10 price comparison

data_authority_boundary.2024_signal_authority: accepted Dukascopy Raw Tick-derived Bid M15
data_authority_boundary.execution_chronology: Dukascopy Raw Bid/Ask Tick for 2023 and 2024
data_authority_boundary.critical_implication: Exact formula parity must use the canonical accepted bars. A Rakuten 2024 MT4 run is a broker-source portability study and must not be mislabeled as exact reproduction of the canonical 2024 signal ledger.
data_authority_boundary.hst_limitation: M15 or M1 HST alone cannot prove first-tick Bid/Ask chronology or exact executable prices
data_authority_boundary.tds_or_raw_tick_requirement: binding execution parity requires TDS with the frozen tick source or an independently validated Raw Tick replay; HST-only evidence is signal/state parity only
